mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd FROM SHT0HG t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{tYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC
